description:
At ABB , we help industries run leaner and cleaner—and every person here makes that happen. You’ll be empowered to lead, supported to grow, and proud of the impact we create together. Join us and help run what runs the world.
 
 This position reports to: 
R&D Team Manager 
 __
 Your role and responsibilities: 
 
 ABB Electrification Installation Products is seeking an R&D Engineer to join our Premier Products R&D team. As part of our team, you'll support innovation and maintain products in industry-leading brands including T&B Fittings®, T&B Liquidtight Systems®, Ocal®, Ty-Duct®, Ty-Rap®, Sta-Kon®, and Color-Keyed®.
 
 In this role, you'll be the technical backbone supporting our manufacturing plants, field teams, and customers. You'll conduct lab testing and technical evaluations, partner with manufacturing facilities, support supply chain with material and supplier evaluations, and collaborate across multiple departments to keep our products compliant and competitive. You'll combine hands-on lab work with cross-functional problem-solving in a dynamic environment where your initiative and technical expertise directly impact product quality and customer satisfaction.
 
 The work model for the role is: Onsite in Memphis, TN. This role is contributing to the ELIP division in US/LATAM. #LI-Onsite
 
 You will be mainly accountable for: 
 Serve as the Subject Matter Expert (SME) for assigned product lines, maintaining deep knowledge of product design, agency certifications, materials, competitive landscape, and manufacturing processes.

 Perform detailed part evaluations across a variety of materials (metals, plastics, etc.) utilizing manufacturing methods such as injection molding, metal stamping, casting, extrusion, machining, and additive manufacturing.

 Prepare and maintain engineering documentation including drawings, BOMs, material specifications, instruction sheets, and quality control plans; develop project progress updates for presentation to executive stakeholders as needed.

 Provide sustaining engineering and R&D support through root cause analysis, product optimization, and timely response to manufacturing requests for engineering assistance.

 Guide test lab personnel in executing testing per agency standards and independently perform internal testing as required.

 Act as a technical resource for cross-functional teams — including Product Management, Technical Services, and manufacturing plants — while supporting new product development projects as needed.

 
 Qualifications for the role: 

 3–5 years of experience in a mechanical or electrical engineering role, with background in product design and/or sustaining engineering.

 Proficiency in 3D modeling software (CREO preferred), with solid knowledge of general product design principles and test plan development.

 Strong cross-functional communication and interpersonal skills, with a proactive ownership mindset and genuine enthusiasm for continuous learning.

 Fluency in English (written and spoken) is required.

 Must hold valid work authorization to work for ABB in the United States.

 
 Preferred Qualifications: 
 Hands-on experience executing and/or performing product and product comparison testing.

 Familiarity with agency certification processes and standards applicable to industrial products.

 Intermediate Spanish proficiency — an advantage for cross-functional and cross-regional communication.

 
 
 What's in it for you: 
 
 We give you the space to lead, the support to grow, and the chance to make a difference. Whether you're solving problems, building something new, or helping others succeed, your impact is real. You’ll be part of a team that values your voice and celebrates your progress.

 Building a cleaner, smarter future takes all kinds of minds: the curious, the courageous, and the creative. That's why we welcome people from all backgrounds and experiences.
 
 Ready to make an impact?
